# ChudClub

> ChudClub is a community site for chuds. Members log in with Steam and get a public profile page.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://chudclub.net/): overview of ChudClub and its members
- [Member profiles](https://chudclub.net/profile/{steamid}): public profile pages for accepted members, showing their Steam stats

## Notes

- Login is handled via Steam OpenID 2.0; there is no public registration form.
- The /admin and /login routes are internal and not part of the public site content.
